label: Simple declarative + prepositional phrase
english: The cat sat on the mat.
german: Die Katze sitzt auf der Matte.
spanish: El gato se sentó en la alfombra.
compare_note: English and Spanish keep subject-before-verb order here. German does too in this sentence. Watch reflexive **se** in Spanish and dative **der** in German.

label: Fronted time adverb
compare_note: English keeps SVO: **Yesterday | I | ate | apple**. German V2 puts the verb second: **Gestern | aß | ich | Apfel**. Spanish often allows the same SVO pattern as English: **Ayer | comí | manzana**.
